description.narrative:
IFC anticipates that the Project would result in improved access to quality lending products for individuals in Brazil. Access to affordable credit remains challenging for a large, underserved population as interest rates remain substantial, driven by high default rates and the lack of a sophisticated credit rating system. The investment will support the Company to scale its offering of secured credit cards with and without leverage, consequently seeking to reach more underbanked low-income individuals in Brazil, enabling them to build a credit history and access more affordable credit and ultimately non-collateralized credit.
Beyond the Project, this investment has the potential to contribute to boosting the inclusiveness of the Brazilian financial system through demonstration and replication by supporting the Company to expand its operations and reach underbanked populations through an innovative platform and inclusive products, demonstrating to other players from the banking sector the commercial viability and business opportunity of strategy focused on this population.

The project consists of an equity investment for a minority stake in Neon Payments Ltd. (Neon, or the Company), a holding company that holds an equity interest in companies regulated by the Brazilian Central Bank that offer secured and unsecured credit, investments, insurance, and financial management tools to the Brazilian mass worker population. IFC is proposing up to US$15 million in preferred equity financing to support the Companys operations.
